channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Landry Fields | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Landry Fields from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Landry Fields
item.description:
“That’s what I like and it’s also what I’m passionate about. Any speculation about me having a more significant role than providing input on personnel decisions is just not accurate. I have total confidence in Landry and his group to make those decisions. As I see it, my job is to maximize the potential of the personnel, whatever the personnel is. That’s where my focus lies. That speculation is erroneous.”

Quin Snyder on Landry Fields, Jun 17, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields
item.description:
“The only role Landry and Kyle (Korver, assistant GM) and I talked about when I agreed to come to Atlanta is me coaching the team,”

Quin Snyder on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields, Jun 17, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Landry Fields
item.description:
“I put Landry as GM, and Kyle as assistant GM, and shortly thereafter, they wanted to make a coaching change and suggested strongly who and how they would go about it,”

Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Mar 3, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields
item.description:
“Right now, we're at 500. I think we should be better than that. I hope we will be better than that. And I can tell you this: Landry and [assistant GM] Kyle [Korver] are running a much better, much more collaborative front office. That's of huge importance to me because I think that's how you get better.”

Antony Ressler on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields, Mar 3, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Landry Fields
item.description:
“Who makes the decisions [now], it's undoubtedly Landry with Kyle -- with Quin. [They] are going to work beautifully together from what I can tell. I do believe we will make better decisions going forward than we have done in the past.”

Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Mar 3, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Travis Schlenk
item.description:
“Between Travis, Landry and Nate, we have a hell of a team in our front office and coaching staff,”

Antony Ressler on Landry Fields, Travis Schlenk, May 6, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Landry Fields
item.description:
“Landry has quickly risen through the ranks, bringing a unique combination of playing experience, sharp eye for player development and strong skills as a communicator. He will be a welcome addition to our group.”

Travis Schlenk on Landry Fields, Oct 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Spike Lee on Landry Fields
item.description:
“But I had three Landry Fields jerseys. So I took it to my guy, and he hooked it up. So officially, this is a Landry Fields jersey.”

Spike Lee on Landry Fields, Feb 12, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Landry Fields
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Casey on Fields (failed secondary concussion test):

“He's alert, looks good, looks as ugly as he's always looked. Those tests are intricate”

Dwane Casey on Landry Fields, Dec 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Glen Grunwald on Landry Fields, Jeremy Lin, Steve Novak
item.description:
Knicks GM Glen Grunwald said on the night of the NBA draft that his priority is re-signing not only Smith, but Jeremy Lin, Steve Novak and Landry Fields.

“We want to keep both (Lin and Novak) and keep Landry and J.R.,”

Glen Grunwald on Landry Fields, Jeremy Lin, Steve Novak, Jul 3, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.
